_doc: SPEC_PET_ATHLETICS §3.1 — the base six-tuple per declared movement_class. The single biggest determinant of a pet's athletics, and one flat table an admin can tune. Keys are the movement_class strings the motion profiles declare (guard test pins the bijection both ways); `default` is the never-raises fallback row for an unknown class, mirroring motion_profiles registry.default. Attributes and affinities are all 0.0-1.0; affinities MULTIPLY performance and never gate entry (§2.2) — eligibility is the pose requirement (§6.3).

mammalian_quadruped._note: The baseline athlete. Strong on land, adequate in water, hopeless in the air.

avian_biped._note: Waddles on the track, owns the sky. The natural premium archetype (§10.3).

winged_flyer._note: Dragons and their kin. Dominant airborne, awkward everywhere else.

humanoid_biped._note: The all-rounder; the air affinity is for the flying superheroes.

primate_walker._note: Power first — built for the jumps once they ship.

aquatic_swimmer._note: Dominant in the pool, comic on the track. The comedy is the design (§0.5).

limbless_serpentine._note: Slow but relentless; the endurance events are where a snake surprises people.
